name: Echoes on the Wire
description: A retired orbital bulletin board still answers on the StratoCyberLab network. Recover the flag from its archive by examining the service and its public records. Scan 172.20.0.0/24; challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199.

tasks.name: Recover the last broadcast
tasks.description: Inspect the bulletin board on the lab network and recover the flag from its archive. Scan 172.20.0.0/24; challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199.
hints: Compare the account artifacts in the public records with the signals returned by the service.
Try the service's built-in mailbox verification feature to check which listed accounts exist.
Verify the listed accounts against the server's own mailbox database, then authenticate with the matching pair and request the archive.
